hard_stops: Do not change or promote the H4-D3 writer, Store.inspect, owner-binding or persistence-lease surface.
Do not compile the D3 writer, owner anchor, persistence lease or H4-C owner-bound projection into the helper.
Do not pass a root descriptor, final descriptor, expected bytes, expected semantic value, owner, lease, coordinator, store, policy or fault selection into the helper.
Do not infer historical producer identity, authenticity, freshness, anti-replay or rollback resistance from self-consistent representation agreement.
Do not reject a canonical schema-valid coherent JSON, CBOR and indexed-scalar substitution merely because it differs from the original publisher value.
Do not add process or signal APIs to production or helper sources; the only permitted calls are the frozen XCTest posix_spawn, poll, WNOHANG waitpid and one timeout SIGKILL path.
Do not use Process.waitUntilExit or any unbounded child wait.
Do not signal a process group, an inferred PID, a nonpositive PID or any process other than the exact direct child returned by the successful spawn.
Do not migrate, rewrite, rename, clean, repair, delete or adopt any D2b/v2 namespace.
Do not add the reader or helper to the application target or add a Hypervisor framework or entitlement to the helper.
Do not call the fixed representation result H4 entry, Gate-E movement, candidate evaluation, scientific authority or an authority transition.
Do not edit, clean, stage or otherwise absorb unrelated dirty files or untracked artifacts.
residuals: A canonical absolute same-uid path is an input locator, not a capability; same-euid, root or Full-Disk-Access actors can mutate the namespace outside the advisory-lock convention.
Shared advisory flock proves only cooperating-reader coordination and does not exclude noncooperating mutation.
Named/opened/post-close joins detect but cannot prevent every same-uid replacement between observations.

Path-based posix_spawn cannot bind execution to the retained helper descriptor; named/held executable revalidation before spawn and after reap detects but cannot prevent every replacement between those observations.
The child validates a retained image after a normal D3 test publication; it does not execute a real crash cut, power loss or device-cache interruption.
The four-second operation deadline and five-second hard horizon are best-effort userspace bounds; an entered kernel call has no independent external supervisor bound.
If the exact child is not reaped after the one permitted SIGKILL by the hard horizon, containment is unproven and no second signal is authorized.
Dynamic loader and Swift/Foundation runtime filesystem activity is outside the application-level one-root read protocol and is not claimed absent.
Canonical JSON, deterministic CBOR and indexed scalar agreement can all be coherently replaced and therefore supplies no external commitment.
nonclaims: D3b proves only the frozen fresh-process local representation-inspection mechanics on its exact implementation and test objects.
The result VALID_V3_DUAL_STREAM_THREE_WAY_JOIN means representation agreement, not validity of the underlying historical claim.
SQLite is a checked non-authoritative container; its schema, integrity result and three-way semantic agreement create no truth or authority.
A newly exec'd process establishes object-lifetime separation from the publisher, not producer authenticity, continuity or anti-replay.
The wider app may configure com.apple.security.hypervisor and link Hypervisor.framework, but the helper has neither and executes no Hypervisor API.
No H4 entry, Gate-E movement, candidate result, scientific conclusion, authority transition or successor stage is authorized by this freeze.
